title: tylophora auriculata
intro: Tylophora auriculata, commonly known as the "Indian ipecacuanha" or "Tylophora", is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Indian medicine for various health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions, which include reducing fever, treating asthma, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Tylophora auriculata include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
